description: Generate a new password for a specific instance's MySQL database. The old password stops working immediately, so every plugin or tool configured with it must be updated. The new password is returned, which is the point of the call. Call get_database_info first to confirm there is a database.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set this only after showing the user exactly what will be changed (the current MySQL password stops working immediately and every plugin or tool using it must be updated) and getting their approval.

instance.description: Instance id (preferred) or exact instance name.

name: reset_database_password
title: Reset Database Password
